engine.tree: the delivered runtime with the M111 vocabulary present and the engine and its consumers still the committed M110 files (the policy stage itself)
engine.scope: The unchanged M111 probes on the pre-hardening runtime: the module can name the states, but the engine still answers a failed read with a quiet payload, so the unknown-specific assertions measure the fail-open rather than a crash.
